cds.title: Pitzer College Common Data Set 2025-2026 (PDF, Institutional Research)

stats.notes: From the Common Data Set 2025-26 (fall 2025 entering class): 3,683 applied (1,594 men + 2,089 women), 989 admitted, 273 enrolled; the residency rows (in-state / out-of-state / international) add up to the totals. International: 1,352 applied, 81 admitted, 18 enrolled. The ED figure covers Early Decision (385 applications, 167 admitted). Pitzer is test-free, so the CDS leaves the SAT/ACT submission rates and percentile ranges blank and no test scores are shown. The GPA breakdown is the 'all enrolled students' column (the printed total is 99.6%; the rows shown sum to 99.7%). Undergraduate enrollment (1,175) is the CDS B2 total of degree-seeking undergraduates and the international count (105) its nonresident degree-seeking undergraduates; all undergraduates incl. non-degree-seeking: 1,193. The admission-factor grid is the 2025-26 C7 as printed.

cost.notes: Published 2026-27 on-campus budget from Pitzer's Cost of Attendance page: tuition $70,184; fees $312; housing $13,470 + food $10,290 (the page prints them separately; shown here as one $23,760 room-and-board figure); books and supplies $1,100; personal expenses $1,300; average loan fees $50. The page prints a total of $96,706. The CDS G1 figures (tuition $67,484, fees $308) are older, so they are not used.
